<!--
Developer Guide – Proposal Issue Template
Classification: Internal – Engineering Standards

Use this template to suggest changes to the Developer Guide.
Maintainers will triage this issue to determine if it is a Minor Change (direct PR) or Major Change (RFC required).
-->

# 1. Problem Statement

**What is the current problem?**
(e.g., "The current logging standards do not cover structured JSON logging," or "The API naming convention is ambiguous regarding plurals.")

> 

**Why is this a problem?**
(e.g., "It causes inconsistency across services," "It creates security risks," "It slows down onboarding.")

> 

---

# 2. Proposed Solution

**Describe the change you want to make:**
(Provide a brief summary of the rule or guideline you want to add/modify.)

> 

**Example (Draft):**

```markdown
### New Guideline Title [RECOMMENDED]
Description of the rule...
```

---

# 3. Proposed Requirement Level

Which level should this rule have? (See `requirements-levels-policy.md`)

- [ ] **[REQUIRED]** (Mandatory - requires strict enforcement)
- [ ] **[RECOMMENDED]** (Strong best practice)
- [ ] **[OPTIONAL]** (Advisory / Style preference)

**Justification for this level:**
(Why should it be enforced at this level?)

> 

---

# 4. Impact Assessment

**Who will be affected by this change?**

- [ ] Single Team / Project
- [ ] Multiple Teams
- [ ] Entire Organization

**Does this introduce a breaking change for existing code?**

- [ ] Yes
- [ ] No

**Does this affect security or compliance (SOX, PCI, etc.)?**

- [ ] Yes
- [ ] No

---

# 5. References & Context

- **Related Issues/Tickets:**
- **External Standards (e.g., OWASP, PEP8):**
- **Internal Discussions (Slack/Teams links):**

# 6. Maintainer Triage (Maintainers Only)

**Classification:**
- [ ] **Minor Change** → Approved for PR
- [ ] **Major Change** → RFC Required
- [ ] **Rejected** → Close with justification
